# Design attribution

The portfolio's layout and CSS adapt the typography, framed grid, and footer patterns of [Brutalistfolio](https://github.com/steelzzeu/brutalistfolio) by Suf Khatib / Steelzz Development, distributed under the MIT License. The original notice is retained in `brutalistfolio-LICENSE.txt`.

The content, Jekyll templates, pure black/white palette, and reduced interaction set are specific to this site.
